Based on the provided screenshot, here are the precise answers to your questions:

(1) **Yes**, there is a sticky action bar (or button group) located directly above the bottom navigation bar. It contains three interactive elements: an "All" (`الكل`) checkbox, an "Delete Selected" (`إلغاء التحديد`) outlined button, and a "Save Changes" (`حفظ التغييرات`) filled button.

(2) **No**, none of the buttons in the action bar are partially covered or cut off by the bottom navigation bar. There is clear vertical spacing separating the action bar from the 4-item bottom navigation menu below it.

(3) **N/A** (Not applicable), as no buttons are covered. However, the text displayed on the buttons in that action area is **"إلغاء التحديد"** (Delete Selected/Cancel Selection) and **"حفظ التغييرات"** (Save Changes).
